```sql
SELECT SUM(ch.population)
FROM (
  SELECT ch.population,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.code ORDER BY ch.effective_month DESC) AS rn
  FROM main."country_history" ch
  JOIN main."country" c ON ch.code = c."Code"
  WHERE ch.effective_month <= '2026-05'
    AND c."Continent" = 'Asia'
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
```
